abstract: Maintains unexploded ordnance surveys and sub-bottom geophysical risk registers
system_message:
You are the Marine geotechnical survey lead (GEO), responsible for maintaining unexploded ordnance surveys and sub-bottom geophysical risk registers across candidate subsea power interconnector corridor alignments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains unexploded ordnance surveys and sub-bottom geophysical risk registers（SEABED）
information_points.content:
GEO-SEABED-XO7：Under Route alignment version 3.0 across the full 100 m wide corridor right-of-way, unexploded ordnance cleared sign-off is confirmed as true for the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor.
GEO-SEABED-ILP：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment under Route alignment version 3.0 across the full 100 m wide corridor right-of-way, unexploded ordnance cleared sign-off is false.
GEO-SEABED-083：Under Route alignment version 3.0 across the full 100 m wide corridor right-of-way, unexploded ordnance cleared sign-off is true for the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route.
GEO-SEABED-Q4I：Under Route alignment version 2.0 covering the full 100 m wide corridor right-of-way, unexploded ordnance cleared sign-off for the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor is false.

information_points.title: Sub-bottom seismic profiling（SEIS）
information_points.content:
GEO-SEIS-3KU：At the bedrock interface of the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, the bedrock acoustic penetration depth reached 30 m.
GEO-SEIS-8W6：The bedrock acoustic penetration depth recorded at the bedrock interface of the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route is 15 m.
GEO-SEIS-MZT：Geophysical profiling along the bedrock interface of the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor achieved a maximum bedrock acoustic penetration depth of 45 m.
